2608.31046.title: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? From Noisy Teacher to Self-Improvement
2608.31046.paper_summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense token-level supervision as an alternative to the sparse outcome-level advantages of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). However, the teacher scores student-generated trajectories that are inherently off-policy for it, so the reliability of its supervision, and hence the source of the student's improvement, remains unclear. We quantitatively analyze teacher supervision during OPD training and find substantial noise whose prevalence increases with teacher scale. Surprisingly, the student policy is insensitive to such noise, converging to comparable performance regardless of whether noisy supervision is retained or removed. Does OPD distill at all? By analyzing what drives its gains, we find that learning concentrates on low log-probability tokens, and using a single fixed negative advantage matches the performance of teacher-provided ones. This suggests that OPD works largely by suppressing low log-probability tokens, which requires no teacher. These findings motivate On-Policy Self-Adaptation (OPSA), a supervision-free method using entropy-adaptive negative advantages. It assigns stronger learning signals to high-entropy positions, suppressing tail tokens, and evenly redistributing probability mass among head tokens. Compared with the base \texttt{Qwen3-1.7B}, OPSA improves Avg@32 by 35.41 points on AIME24, corresponding to a 263\% relative gain, and more than doubles Pass@32 across all three benchmarks. It also outperforms OPD by 16.77 points in Avg@32 on AIME24. Extensive experiments and analyses across model families and tasks further demonstrate its effectiveness and generalizability.
2608.31046.paper_summary_zh: 在政策蒸餾（OPD）中，提供了密集的標記級別監督，作為具有可驗證獎勵的強化學習（RLVR）稀疏結果級別優勢的替代方案。<lb/>然而，教師對學生生成的軌跡進行評分，而這些軌跡對教師來說本質上是非政策的，因此其監督的可靠性，以及學生改進的來源，仍然不明確。<lb/>我們定量分析了OPD訓練期間的教師監督，發現存在大量噪聲，且隨著教師規模的增大而增加。<lb/>令人驚訝的是，學生政策對這種噪聲不敏感，無論保留還是去除噪聲監督，其性能都會收斂到相似的水平。<lb/>OPD究竟有沒有進行蒸餾？通過分析其增益的驅動因素，我們發現學習集中在低對數概率的標記上，並且使用單一固定的負優勢可以匹配教師提供的性能。<lb/>這表明，OPD主要通過抑制低對數概率的標記來運作，這不需要教師。<lb/>這些發現促使了無監督的政策自適應（OPSA）的提出，這是一種使用熵自適應負優勢的方法。<lb/>它對高熵位置分配更強的學習信號，抑制尾部標記，並在頭部標記之間均勻重新分配概率質量。<lb/>與基準的 \texttt{Qwen3-1.7B} 相比，OPSA 在 AIME24 上將 Avg@32 提高了 35.41 分，對應於 263\% 的相對增益，並且在所有三個基準上將 Pass@32 的值增加了兩倍以上。<lb/>它在 AIME24 的 Avg@32 上也比 OPD 超出 16.77 分。<lb/>在模型系列和任務上的廣泛實驗和分析進一步證明了其有效性和可泛化性。
